info.name: Risk Cloud Access Audit Workflow Map API

params.name: workflow-id
params.description: The unique ID of a workflow where, if provided, the response will only contain workflow maps from the identified workflow

params.name: page
params.description: The zero-indexed page number (must not be less than 0, defaults to 0)

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the page and maximum number of items to be returned (must not be less than 1, defaults to 20)

items.docs:
**Permissions:** [Build Access](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402683190164-Control-Build-Access-for-Applications)

Retrieve a page of all workflow maps that the current user has [Build Access to a parent application](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402683190164-Control-Build-Access-for-Applications) to.

**Permissions:** [Build Access to parent applications](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402683190164-Control-Build-Access-for-Applications)
